messages:
deploy-bot: Deploy started for release/2026.03.20 - rolling canary. auto-checks running.
maya: Kicking off FF ramp for adaptive-routing-v2 at 5%. plan: 5 -> 25 -> 100 with 10m soak each. windows: quiet window until 02:00 UTC.
dmitri: Confirmed metric targets: p95 latency + error-rate anomaly. rollback if p95 > 300ms or error rate delta > 3% for 2 consecutive 10m windows.
carla: Noted. Pin 10% of EU traffic to routing-v1 (legacy) for the first two steps to protect regional users.
ops-oncall: I'll watch infra. If GPU queue length spikes > 40% we'll throttle the ramp. :eyes:
deploy-bot: preflight checks: config-validate ok, infra-capacity ok, canary health ok. flag service reachable.
maya: Toggling flag: `/ff set adaptive-routing-v2 --cohort 0.05` -> deploy-bot: `adaptive-routing-v2 = 5% (canary)`
carla: Release notes updated: https://redwood.internal/releases/2026.03.20/adaptive-routing-v2 - added rollout matrix + rollback criteria.
dmitri: Telemetry links: p95 dashboard https://dash.redwood/prod/p95?service=routing , errors https://dash.redwood/prod/errors?service=routing
ops-oncall: Seeing small p50 bump +1ms, p95 steady. no errors. :thumbsup:
maya: Advancing to 25% in 12m unless we see anomalies. scheduling: `/ff set adaptive-routing-v2 --cohort 0.25` at 4102468720
deploy-bot: scheduled cohort change recorded by deploy-bot (actor=maya).
carla: Quick heads-up: the A/B eval test will run on 25% cohort — watch response distribution for rerank regressions.
dmitri: If we see any model-quality drift > 0.8% we'll pause and roll back to 5% (manual). set alert ok?
ops-oncall: Alerts configured: routing_quality_delta > 0.8% -> pager. latency_slo_breach -> channel alert.
maya: Late note: if EU latency trends up, we'll pin EU fully to v1 via `/ff set adaptive-routing-v2 --region eu --cohort 0.0` and open incident.
deploy-bot: cohort advanced: adaptive-routing-v2 = 25% (canary). change_ts=4102468050
ops-oncall: monitoring - nothing unusual yet. breaking down token-cost per-request looks normal.
carla: FYI, post-deploy followup: doc added to release checklist with rollback commands and postmortem template.
maya: Planning final cutover to 100% at 02:00 UTC if no alerts. will post final confirm 15m prior. :rocket:
dmitri: Copy. I'll keep an eye on canary cohorts and start bisect if we see regressions.
ops-oncall: Ready to execute rollback steps if thresholds hit. ping me @ops-oncall.
maya: Thanks team, keeping channel open.
deploy-bot: Deploy finished: rollout in progress, 25% active. next scheduled action at 4102468720.
